workouts.title: Full Body Starter
workouts.description: Sample workout: edit or delete it on the coach page. Five moves that train your whole body with one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cues: Hold the dumbbell at your chest. Sit back and down, chest up, knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cues: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Drop to your knees if you need to.

exercises.name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.cues: Flat back, pull the elbow towards your hip, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cues: Feet flat, push through your heels, squeeze at the top for one second.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cues: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze your glutes, do not let your hips sag.

workouts.title: 20-Minute HIIT
workouts.description: Sample workout: edit or delete it on the coach page. 40 seconds on, 20 seconds off, four rounds.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.cues: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.cues: Step back instead of jumping if your wrists or knees need it.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.cues: Keep your hips level with your shoulders.
